description: Hook points fired by aos-eca-turn (the eca body), and before_compact / after_compact fired by the eca-claude template's compact_hook from Claude Code's own compaction hooks; tool hooks are in ../mcp/hook_points.json, the loop points in ../hook/loop_points.json.

before_queue.when: turn: every good letter before it is handed to the CLI, slash letters too; also letters that arrive while waiting for the answer

fields.content: the text that will be handed over

before_queue.if_blocked: the letter is closed and dropped; mailbox_warning.txt says which hook dropped it

after_queue.when: the letter was handed to the CLI, joined history and was closed; a failing hook is reported only after the answer is in history

fields.content: the text that was handed over

brain_failed.when: turn: the CLI failed after the letters were handed over

fields.name: error code: CliFailed or ReplyMissing
fields.code: claude only: the same error code
fields.retry: claude only: true when the letters are sent again after a cooldown
fields.attempt: claude only: failures in a row
fields.dropped: claude only: how many letters were dropped
fields.wait_s: claude only, when retry is true: seconds of cooldown
fields.status: claude only, when known: the HTTP status
fields.cause: claude only, when known: the CLI's own failure cause

brain_failed.subject: code

tool_added.when: turn: before each handoff to the CLI, a tool name appeared in this agent's tool registry (the first look only remembers the names)
tool_added.subject: tool

on_clock.when: start of every turn (also turns in a cooldown or that give way): the hook's clock moved on by its own every_cycles / every_ms

fields.first: true right after a start, a wake or a clock change
fields.last_cycle: cycle of the last run, or null
fields.config: the entry's config, when it has one

before_compact.when: claude kind only, from the definition's compact_hook, which the eca-claude template wires as Claude Code's own PreCompact hook (cli.json settings): Claude Code is about to compact the conversation, for a /compact or on its own; pi and codex do not fire it

fields.trigger: manual (a /compact) or auto (Claude Code compacts on its own)
fields.asked: the words after /compact, or an empty string
fields.instructions: the summary instructions compact_hook gives Claude Code on top of asked (the template's list of what to keep); a hook may change them, an empty string gives none
fields.restore: null; a hook may set text that compact_hook adds to the compacted conversation (through Claude Code's SessionStart compact hook, after the handoff notes), for this compaction only

before_compact.if_blocked: compact_hook exits 2 and Claude Code does not compact; for a /compact the CLI says the hook's name and stdout, an automatic compaction is skipped (or the request that needed the room fails); the summary and history stay as they were

after_compact.when: claude kind only, from compact_hook as Claude Code's own PostCompact hook: the conversation was compacted; it only tells (nothing can be changed any more; text to add after the compaction is before_compact's restore, since Claude Code runs its SessionStart compact hook before PostCompact)

fields.trigger: manual or auto, as for before_compact
fields.summary: the summary Claude Code wrote, or null
